title: Better Vanilla Cobblemon
description: A Cobblemon focused modpack focused on roleplay. Featuring QoL for both Cobblemon and base minecraft.
body:
This pack blends the freshness of vanilla Minecraft 1.21.1 with Cobblemon, enhanced by thoughtful tweaks and optimizations. The pack will hopefully scratch the itch from waiting for the 1.7 update.

✨ What’s inside:

Vanilla 1.21.1 Experience – Perfect for players who want to explore the newest update without losing that classic Minecraft feel.

Cobblemon, with Flavor – More than just Pokémon in Minecraft: enjoy personalized and immersive features that make your journey unique.

Quality-of-Life Upgrades – Subtle enhancements to vanilla gameplay, making building, exploring, and surviving smoother while staying true to the base game.

Performance Optimization – Carefully chosen mods ensure a lag-free, stable experience so you can focus on catching, crafting, and adventuring.

Whether you’re a builder, a trainer, or an adventurer, this modpack offers a balanced, optimized, and flavorful take on Minecraft + Cobblemon.
